phrases.he: מאחר שאינן נבדלים מן העצם כלל
phrases.en: because each of these attributes are not separate from the essence at all, from the self at all.

phrases.he: כמו מדת חפץ חסד ההיולי הנזכר לעיל
phrases.en: Like for example, the attribute of kindness,
that it's impressed in his nature and in his self.

blocks.text: Why not? **Because each of these attributes are not separate from the essence at all, from the self at all.** There is no wisdom or kindness without a person; they cannot be separated from the human essence behind them.
**Like for example, the attribute of kindness**, which really only people have: **it's impressed in his nature and in his self**, a property he has, not a separate thing put on him.

blocks.title: Water and a car engine
blocks.text: Impressed in the nature of a thing, like water: it boils and freezes at certain temperatures, dissolves things, expands when it freezes, and no part of it freezes while another part boils. A car is different: take out the engine and you have "a car that only works downhill," and the engine can run something else. No property of water has an existence of its own; they are the nature of the molecule, all or nothing.
It is not a perfect analogy, and the Mitteler Rebbe does not give it here. It only explains what "impressed in the nature and the self" means.

So with human nature: every person, by being a person, has the potential for kindness, and without it he is not a person. Of someone who seems to have no kindness at all they say he is a monster, not a person; and really even such people have it, they just hardly show it.

And someone who seems only kind and never angry, they say is not human, maybe an angel, until they see him get angry and realize he is human after all. Kindness and a natural sense of justice are both inseparable from human nature.

phrases.he: הגם שהוא חלק אחד הנמשך מעצם הנפש ממש, שלמעלה מהיות חפץ חסד בעצמיות,
phrases.en: The idea of kindness is only one detail that comes from the essence of the soul, and really the essence of the soul is higher than being kindness.

phrases.he: שזהו ענין פרטי ממהותה העצמית הפשוטה בתכלית
phrases.en: This is only one little aspect of my real self, which is really simple, completely simple.

phrases.he: מכל מקום אי אפשר לומר בו שמתאחד במדת נצוח ההיולית הנטוע בעצם הנפש,
phrases.en: Nevertheless, you can't say that it's like a separate thing that unites with the attribute of victory, of winning, competitiveness, that's in you,

phrases.he: מאחר שמיוחדים שניהם בעצמות ואינן נבדלים כלל וכלל מן העצם
phrases.en: because they're totally one in yourself, and they're not at all separate from yourself; they're just really you.

blocks.text: **The idea of kindness is only one detail that comes from the essence of the soul, and really the essence of the soul is higher than being kindness.** A person is not defined by kindness; he also has justice and the rest.

The whole person is not kindness, and though the *nimshal* (what the analogy stands for) is still ahead, he cannot hold himself back: surely G-d is not just kindness. To say G-d is only kindness, without *gevura*, "is heresy. That's making G-d more limited even than a person."

So you cannot say, I am kindness. You are you, and **this is only one little aspect of my real self, which is really simple, completely simple**, above kindness: "I don't have to be nice if I don't want to." That is why you have choice: you are above all of them and choose how to express yourself.

**Nevertheless, you can't say that it's like a separate thing that unites with the attribute of victory, of winning, competitiveness, that's in you, because they're totally one in yourself, and they're not at all separate from yourself; they're just really you.** There is just you: where there is a potential for kindness you come out as kindness, where there is one for competition, as competition. One simple human essence expressing itself in different ways.

sections.title: More meshalim: the cat's power of movement, consciousness, and the sun
sections.summary: The power of movement in a living thing, the soul's consciousness before it spreads into the eye and the ear, and the light in the body of the sun all show the same relation: the essence includes every particular that will come out of it, yet in the essence there is no movement, no seeing, no light at all. We speak of the particulars as united there only from the side of what will come out.

phrases.en: Like for example,
the power of movement,
the way that it's included within the essence of a living thing, within like an animal,
before it moved,
it's not separate from the self at all.

phrases.he: אף על פי שבגלוי כח התנועה להניע דבר פרט, יתחלק לכמה פרטי אופנים,
phrases.en: Even though when it's revealed and it actually moves, then it becomes a bunch of particular movements,

phrases.he: אי אפשר לומר שכל אופני פרטי התנועה כלולים ומתאחדים היו, כשהיה כח התנועה נכלל בעצם החי
phrases.en: we can't say that all of these particular movements existed as separate things and were united in this power of movement the way that it's in the essence of the cat,

phrases.he: מאחר שאז לא היה בסוג וגדר תנועה כלל,
phrases.en: because then, the way that it was included in the essence, it wasn't in the whole realm or category of movement at all,
not in general and not in particular.

blocks.text: That ends this analogy. More follow: this is the main one, but no analogy is perfect, so each fills in where the others fall short.

blocks.title: The cat that ate its cat food
blocks.text: **Like for example, the power of movement, the way that it's included within the essence of a living thing**, **before it moved**: **it's not separate from the self at all.** A healthy cat has eaten its cat food and has the energy to move, but until it moves that strength is not separate from it. Asleep, it just lies there breathing; you see nothing, yet by being alive it can move.

blocks.title: The cat stalking a mouse
blocks.text: **Even though when it's revealed and it actually moves, then it becomes a bunch of particular movements**: stalking a mouse, the cat creeps up, crouches, pounces, slams its paw down, bats the mouse around and eats it, every movement calculated, measuring exactly how to pounce.

Yet **we can't say that all of these particular movements existed as separate things and were united in this power of movement the way that it's in the essence of the cat**: a power for the right paw, another for the left, one for crouching, one for pouncing. For the soul it is surely one thing, and even in the body the cat eats no special food for each foot. One simple energy; the muscles and bones shape how it moves, and the cat's control tells it to move this or that.

The same signal moves the right arm or the left; it is only sent to one or the other. The soul tells the brain, the brain sends an electrochemical impulse down the nerves, a muscle pulls, and which muscle decides the movement. One simple ability to control the body, and physically one simple energy from food, also called the power of movement.

blocks.title: One outlet for the toaster and the radio
blocks.text: Like electricity: you do not need one outlet for the toaster and another for the radio. Electricity is an essence of force; plug in whatever you want. So the cat's energy from its food is the essence of movement and includes every movement, and its soul has the spiritual power that directs the body. Either way, the individual movements are not there as separate things.

**Because then, the way that it was included in the essence, it wasn't in the whole realm or category of movement at all, not in general and not in particular**: not this arm or that, not up or down, and surely not "twitching its top left whisker." It includes all the details, yet *mamash* clearly they are not there as individual things: a higher, simple essence everything comes out of.

phrases.he: וכן בחינת גילוי התפשטות החיות להחיות כל הגוף בעודנו כלול לגמרי בעצם רוח החיים
phrases.en: The same thing with consciousness, the soul's power of consciousness, before it spreads out into the body to give it life, the way that it's just included in the essence of your soul.
So even though when it's revealed,

phrases.he: מתחלק לראיה ושמיעה לעין ואוזן וכהאי גוונא
phrases.en: when your consciousness is revealed, it goes into your eye and into your ear and becomes seeing and hearing and the like,

phrases.he: שבודאי גם טרם בואו להתגשם בעין ואוזן בפועל,
phrases.en: surely even before it was revealed, before you actually saw something or actually heard something,

phrases.he: היה כלול בו חיות הראיה הרוחנית לעין בפני עצמו, וחיות השמיעה באוזן בפני עצמו
phrases.en: your soul had the ability to see and to hear.
Nevertheless,

phrases.he: קודם שבאה עצם הנפש לכלל בחינת התפשטות החיות,
phrases.en: before the essence of the soul came to actually go into your body and perceive things, and see, and hear, and feel,
even though these abilities are included in it,

phrases.he: הרי זה כהתכללות כח התנועה בעצם החי הנזכר לעיל
phrases.en: this is the same way that the power of movement is included in the essence of the cat.

blocks.text: **The same thing with consciousness, the soul's power of consciousness, before it spreads out into the body to give it life, the way that it's just included in the essence of your soul**, as when you sit in a dark, quiet room perceiving nothing. Revealed, it becomes seeing, hearing, feeling, tasting and smelling, but it is the same power for hearing and for seeing.

Even physically it is one thing. Eyes and ears lead to the brain, and there the eye's signal is no different from the ear's, except in the part of the brain it reaches or its order. The same impulses fly through your brain, and it perceives them as different things.

**So even though when it's revealed,** it **goes into your eye and into your ear and becomes seeing and hearing**, **surely even before it was revealed, before you actually saw something or actually heard something,** **your soul had the ability to see and to hear.** This analogy shows it clearly, because your eye does not really see: your soul sees.

blocks.title: If a tree falls in the forest
blocks.text:
Even science distinguishes physical from psycho-physical things. Loudness is how you perceive a sound; the physical thing is how much air it pushes, the amplitude. So does a tree falling in a forest with nobody to hear it make a sound? No: it moves a lot of air, but the sound exists only in your head.

So too there is no real color in the world. Light bounces off things at different frequencies, hits your eye, which signals the brain, and your soul sees colors. It all comes from your soul.

Since it all comes from your soul, the different colors and sounds, and seeing and hearing as different things, must already be included in it; otherwise where would the differences come from? Not from your eyes and ears, which only trigger it to be revealed. So it is a *hiyuli* again.

blocks.title: "I can't see that chair"
blocks.text: Once you have the power of seeing, you can see everything. Nobody is shown a chair and answers that he can see other things, just not that chair. Color blindness and the like are a defect of the eye, like a blindfold: the power to see is still there, only not revealed.

blocks.title: Out of salt-passing movements
blocks.text: So too with movement. Nobody can say, "I'd love to pass you the salt, but I ran out of passing-the-salt movements." Once you have the essence, you have everything.

**Nevertheless, before the essence of the soul came to actually go into your body and perceive things**, **even though these abilities are included in it, this is the same way that the power of movement is included in the essence of the cat**: no particular seeing or hearing there, as no particular movements. They are revealed only in the body; there it is one simple ability to be conscious.

phrases.he: וכל מה שמוכן ועתיד לבוא לידי גלוי בפועל החיות עדיין,
phrases.en: As long as you're talking about what's going to come out,

phrases.he: יתכן היחוד וההתכללות דראיה ושמיעה וכהאי גוונא
אבל כאשר כלול לגמרי בעצם הנפש
phrases.en: but when we're speaking about the way it was included completely in the self, the essence of the soul,

phrases.he: והיה כלא יש במציאות התפשטות חיות כלל וכלל
phrases.en: if you look at the essence of the soul, the whole idea of consciousness, it's as if it doesn't exist.

phrases.he: מצד עצם הנפש שלמעלה הרבה מבחינת התפשטות,
phrases.en: When you're looking at it from the point of view of the essence of the soul, which is much higher than spreading out to be conscious of things in a body,

phrases.he: רק שכולל בעצמות גם כן בחינת ההתפשטות,
phrases.en: just that the essence also includes this ability to perceive things,

phrases.he: כעצם החי שכולל בעצמו כח התנועה כנזכר לעיל
phrases.en: just like the essence of a living thing that includes the power of movement.

blocks.text: **As long as you're talking about what's going to come out**, you ask: in the body, can the soul see? Yes. Hear? Yes. Revealed, they differ, so you say the soul has them all, as if it put together a set of different things, because you are tracing back from what is revealed.

**But when we're speaking about the way it was included completely in the self, the essence of the soul**, as it is now and not as it will come into the body, **the whole idea of consciousness, it's as if it doesn't exist.** There is no perceiving there.

**When you're looking at it from the point of view of the essence of the soul, which is much higher than spreading out to be conscious of things in a body**, there is no seeing or hearing, just the soul, **just that the essence also includes this ability to perceive things**: "also," *gam kein*, is the main word; **just like the essence of a living thing that includes the power of movement.** A cat at rest has no movements, only the ability. So the essence of the soul has no colors or sounds; only when it comes out can you speak of different things.

phrases.he: אם כן איך יתכן בחינת היחוד והתכללות דפרטי אור וחיות
phrases.en: If so, when is it fitting to speak about the unity and the inclusion of all the particular lights and consciousness, feelings?

phrases.he: רק מצד שעתיד ומוכן לצאת בהתפשטות חיות בהתחלקות פרטי חיות
phrases.en: Only because you're saying that when it comes into the body, then it's going to be divided into seeing and hearing and all these,
From this we're forced to say,

phrases.he: שיש כל פרטים הללו בהתפשטות הכלולה בעצם לגמרי,
phrases.en: you must say that every single detail that's going to come out was already included in the essence, in the soul.

phrases.he: שאם לא כן מאין נמצאו פרטים הללו
phrases.en: Because if not, where do they come from
when they're revealed?

phrases.he: כמו האור וזיו שכלול בעצם השמש,
phrases.en: Like the light and the ray that was included in the essence of the sun,

phrases.he: שיש בו בהעלם כל פרטי אופני זיו המתפשט וכהאי גוונא ודי למבין.

blocks.text: **If so, when is it fitting to speak about the unity and the inclusion of all the particular lights and consciousness, feelings? Only because you're saying that when it comes into the body, then it's going to be divided into seeing and hearing and all these**, colors, sounds, tastes and smells. Speaking of how it will come out, you can say those things were included and united there.

**From this we're forced to say** **that every single detail that's going to come out was already included in the essence, in the soul. Because if not, where do they come from when they're revealed?** Not as separate things: there is no seeing and hearing there yet, and there they are really the same. Only in the body, in the physical world, do they differ, so we say they all came from there.

blocks.title: The sun and the light bulb filament
blocks.text: **Like the light and the ray that was included in the essence of the sun.** The sun is a big ball of hydrogen undergoing nuclear fusion; in its body there is no light, only stuff so hot that its nature causes light. Like a light bulb filament: the wire has no light in it, but electricity makes it glow, and even while it glows the wire is not light. "If you look inside the wire, you still don't see light."

blocks.title: Every ray and color is in the sun
blocks.text: Still, the sun makes not just white light but each ray and color. A slightly different sun would make a different mix and not look white; stars have different colors depending on what they are made of. Every detail of its rays, ultraviolet, infrared, heat, the growth of plants, comes from the sun, and yet as they are in it, there is no light yet at all.

The exact light through our window, traced back through space, comes from the sun, and there is light even in the bits of space between pieces of the sun. But in its actual stuff there is none. We say the sun has red and blue, but in its body none of these are there; it can only bring them all out.

So the essence of the soul: coming out, it has all these things, but in itself their whole idea does not exist yet, because it is their higher source. Have the sun and you have light, but the sun is far above light: "It's not like a big ball of light, and it's just leaking it out slowly." It makes light, and does other things too.

Analogies in *Chassidus* are very exact. When there is more than one there is a reason, and they are chosen because they actually come from the spiritual thing they describe. So stick to the book's analogies; once you grasp the general idea, you can see it in everything.

blocks.title: Mozart as a little kid
blocks.text: You see the same in a talent for music. Mozart as a little kid could not just write out all his songs, because in his talent they were not there yet; yet only he would come up with them, out of his style and talent, by bringing it out. But the main analogies are the ones given here.

*V'dai l'mevin* ("and this is enough for one who understands"): you will understand if you know how to read the analogies, which part applies and which to throw out. Any metaphor takes common sense to see what is meant.

blocks.title: An eagle in the sky
blocks.text: Call a warplane "an eagle in the sky" and nobody asks what you mean, it was a plane: a metaphor says a thing is what it is not. So here the analogies are not at all what we are talking about, and none of their limitations apply. There are maybe two or three points to bring out, and the rest you forget.

That is not being *magshim* (making physical). Some think that since *Chassidus* forbids it, the *meshalim* should not be taken as simple physical things, but the Rebbe says they should: the more simply and physically, as something you see in daily life, the better. The *nimshal* is where it is not like the *mashal*: do not think it is *mamash* like this. So the next chapter will remove many of the analogies' limitations. Like Rabbi Meir with the pomegranate: "Eat the fruit and throw out the peel."

sections.title: Three levels in the soul: Yachid, Echad and Kadmon
sections.summary: From the *yechida* come three levels, one after the other. First, the ten essential *hiyuli* powers, included in the self as movement is in a living thing: no separate things at all (*Yachid*). Second, the powers ready to come to a particular thing, where many details are united in one general point (*Echad*). Third, everything estimated and prepared in detail, lacking only the deed (*Kadmon*).

phrases.en: So it comes out

phrases.he: ג' מדריגות זה אחר זה נמשך מעצמיות הנפש ממש, הנקרא בחינת יחידה
phrases.en: that there are three levels, one after the other, that come from the essence of the soul, which is called *yechida*.

blocks.text: **So it comes out that there are three levels, one after the other, that come from the essence of the soul, which is called yechida.** The analogy for *Yachid*, *Echad* and *Kadmon* is how the powers of the soul come out of the *yechida*, in three corresponding steps.

phrases.en: The first step:
are the ten essential and *hiyuli* powers, the self and essential powers,
like the essential desire and kindness in the self,
and the like with any other thing, with desire for *gevura*, or desire for *netzach*, or anything else,
just like the way the power of movement is in the essence of the living thing,

phrases.he: וכהתכללות התפשטות החיות בעצם כנזכר לעיל
phrases.en: in the same way, with the inclusion of consciousness in the self.

blocks.text: **The first step:** **are the ten essential and hiyuli powers, the self and essential powers, like the essential desire and kindness in the self, and the like with any other thing, with desire for gevura, or desire for netzach, or anything else.**

They are completely included in him: part of who he is, is kindness, *gevura* (severity and judgement), and *netzach*, to win. **Just like the way the power of movement is in the essence of the living thing**: in the cat it is no movement at all, only the power by its nature. **In the same way, with the inclusion of consciousness in the self**: no sights or sounds yet, only a soul whose nature is to be conscious, not yet as a separate entity.

phrases.he: ולא יתכן בהם לומר לשון התאחדות מדברים נבדלים יחד
phrases.en: You can't say that there's like these separate things that are put together there,
because they're totally included in the self; it's really just the self.

phrases.he: והיה כלא היה במציאות כלל וכלל כנזכר לעיל
phrases.en: It's as if they don't exist at all, because only the self exists at this point.

blocks.text: At this stage, in the essence of the soul, *chesed* and *gevura* are not two things; there is just the person, his humanness, which in the world comes out sometimes as kindness and sometimes as severity. So with movement: no movements, just life. And with perception: no sights, sounds or colors, just the soul. So **you can't say that there's like these separate things that are put together there**, because they do not exist yet.

**Because they're totally included in the self; it's really just the self. It's as if they don't exist at all, because only the self exists at this point.** By its nature it can give rise to them, but they are not distinct there; to the self they are all the same.

phrases.en: In the second stage

phrases.he: בחינת התפשטות י' כחות שמוכנים לבא בבחינת גלוי
phrases.en: is the extension of the ten powers of the soul when they're ready to be revealed,

phrases.he: כמו חפץ חסד העצמי ההיולי שבא לדבר חסד בדרך פרט
phrases.en: like, for example, when a person's inner desire for kindness comes to a particular thing,
even before he did it, so he didn't actually give the person the thing yet,

phrases.he: רק כשעתיד ומוכן לצאת לדבר פרט
phrases.en: just that it's ready to come to this particular thing.
At this point

phrases.he: יתכן ענין האחדות מכמה פרטים שבו
כמו שכל ומדות שבחפץ חסד זה
phrases.en: like the intellect and emotions in this desire for kindness,
when the *chesed* comes out from the hiddenness of the *hiyuli*.

blocks.text: **In the second stage is the extension of the ten powers of the soul when they're ready to be revealed, like, for example, when a person's inner desire for kindness comes to a particular thing**: a birthday present, or the coat or the shoes.

blocks.title: The coat at the door, before the details
blocks.text: **Even before he did it, so he didn't actually give the person the thing yet, just that it's ready to come to this particular thing.** He opens the door, sees the poor man and wants to help. He knows he will give him a coat, but not which one, where it is, or whether to buy one or give an old one. In his chair before the knock he was just a nice guy; now his kindness wants a particular thing.

**At this point** there is one general desire, to give him a coat, which already holds many details. He does not see them as distinct yet, because they are coming together, but they already *mamash* exist there.

**Like the intellect and emotions in this desire for kindness.** Once the desire comes out, the *sechel* and *middos* it will need are included and revealed in it, waiting to be brought into each detail. He knows he will need a *sechel* to work out the best way and the right coat for this man, and certain emotions, but he sees them as one general thing.

blocks.title: The right-size coat
blocks.text: The final product, the right coat, can be a kindness, and it is made of many acts and parts; *davka* (precisely) when they come together it is the real kindness. Without his *sechel*, the wrong-size coat would not really be a kindness, "especially if it's too small."

So at this stage there are actual levels, coming together once it relates to a particular thing. **When the chesed comes out from the hiddenness of the hiyuli**, the details are there, but included: the level of *Echad*.

phrases.en: In the third stage,
when it comes to actually do this particular thing,

phrases.he: רק שעדיין לא בא מצד העדר ומניעה
phrases.en: but it just didn't happen yet because something is holding him back;
but from his part he's totally ready to do it,

phrases.he: ולא חסר רק לבא בהתגלות בפועל ממש
phrases.en: he just didn't actually do it yet.

phrases.he: דהיינו שכבר שיער היטב בעצמו בדרך פרט לאותו דבר שבא לפועל ממש
phrases.en: That means that he already estimated very well in himself, in a detailed way, for that thing, how it's going to come in actuality.

phrases.he: והיינו שיער בעצמו בכח מה שצריך להביא בפועל
phrases.en: And this means that he estimates in himself, in potential, what he's going to need to do in actuality.

blocks.text: **In the third stage, when it comes to actually do this particular thing, but it just didn't happen yet because something is holding him back; but from his part he's totally ready to do it**, knowing exactly what to do: **he just didn't actually do it yet.**

blocks.title: Locked out with the coat
blocks.text: He has the perfect coat and knows just what to do with it. Then the wind blows the door shut and he is locked out with the man; he must ring the bell and wait to be let in before he can give the coat. But it is all prepared.

**That means that he already estimated very well in himself, in a detailed way, for that thing, how it's going to come in actuality**, estimating in potential what he will need to do in actuality. That is the level of *Kadmon*.

sections.title: The three levels in movement, consciousness and growth, and the tzimtzum before the deed
sections.summary: The same three stages are in the power of movement, in consciousness and in the power of growth, all before anything actually happens. To pass from spiritual to physical there must first be a *tzimtzum* that narrows the power to one particular way: a decision, a sound or light hitting the senses, a seed in the ground. That is chapter 12.

phrases.he: כמו על דרך דוגמא הנזכר לעיל בכח התנועה
phrases.en: Like in the analogy of the power of movement,
when the power of movement is ready to come out to a particular thing,

phrases.he: וכמו התפשטות החיות להחיות לגוף כשמוכן לצאת
phrases.en: and the same thing with the power of consciousness, that it's going to come out,

phrases.he: שכלולים שם ביחוד כללי כל החיות פרטיי'
phrases.en: that at that stage, all the details are included in one, in a general thing.

blocks.text: **Like in the analogy of the power of movement**: now he contrasts the second and third stages in the other analogies. **When the power of movement is ready to come out to a particular thing**, reaching for the salt or throwing the ball into the hoop, you already know what movement you want. **And the same thing with the power of consciousness, that it's going to come out**: it has gone from your soul into your brain as general consciousness, ready to go to your eye and become seeing.

blocks.title: Reaching for the salt
blocks.text: **At that stage, all the details are included in one, in a general thing.** Once the power of movement is in your body, all the detailed movements are there. Reaching for the salt, you do not think about extending your arm and closing your fingers; you want the salt, and the little movements follow.

blocks.title: The basketball shot
blocks.text: Like basketball: in practice you hold the ball, flick your wrist, bend your knees, but once you have learned it you think only of the goal, the ball in the hoop, and do the details without thinking. You do a better job focused on the goal; thinking about your wrist is distracting.

phrases.en: And after that,

phrases.he: הוא מה ששיער והכין כבר בכח התנועה איך להניע דרך פרט
phrases.en: you have to have that estimation and prepare exactly how you're going to move.

phrases.he: וכן מה ששיער התגלות התפשטות רוח החיים, והוכן בו מה שעתיד להחיות בפועל ממש
phrases.en: In the same way with the power of consciousness, it has to become estimated exactly how it's going to come out.
And similarly, the power of growth of a plant,
when it's ready to grow in actuality,

phrases.he: שיש בזה גם כן ענין ג' מדריגות הללו
phrases.en: that there also, you see these three stages also in the power of growth.

blocks.title: Why one shot goes in
blocks.text: **And after that, you have to have that estimation and prepare exactly how you're going to move.** Two people want the ball in the hoop and one gets it in, because he practiced and knows how to estimate it. That *shiur*, the *hashara* (estimation), has to be in your power of movement first.

**In the same way with the power of consciousness, it has to become estimated exactly how it's going to come out.** Going from the brain to the eye, before you see anything, it becomes ready to see, and will not hear from your eye; in your ear it becomes ready to hear. Ready for only a sight or only a sound: already an estimation in potential of how it will come out.
**And similarly**, a new *mashal* the Mitteler Rebbe did not bring before: **the power of growth of a plant**, **when it's ready to grow in actuality**, **there also, you see these three stages.**

phrases.he: והכל הוא טרם שבא הדבר עדיין בפועל ממש
phrases.en: But this is all before it actually happens.

blocks.title: The power of growth in the ground
blocks.text: **But this is all before it actually happens.** Growth has three stages: first, the power of growth, a spiritual thing above growing any plant. Then the general power as it comes into the dirt, which can grow nearly anything, though the dirt itself is just dirt that also can grow; now it comes in a limited way, and some ground suits some things better. Then it is ready to grow a particular tree, an apple tree, but has not grown it yet.

He thinks the Mitteler Rebbe brings this analogy because here you see the need for the *tzimtzum*, explained in chapter 12: growth needs a seed. The ground may have the potential for any tree, even this exact tree, but without a seed nothing grows.

phrases.he: כמו התנועה קודם שבאה בגשם הנפעל
phrases.en: Like the power of movement before it actually comes into the physical thing that is moved,

phrases.he: או החיות הרוחני קודם שבא בגשם הגוף
phrases.en: or the spiritual power of consciousness before it comes into the actual body to actually perceive,

phrases.he: ששם משתנה ממהות רוחנית למהות גשם,
phrases.en: that there, when it goes into the body or the physical thing, it changes from a spiritual thing to a physical thing.

phrases.he: שהוא בחינת תנועה גשמיות והחיות גשמיות
phrases.en: Then it becomes a physical movement, that your hand moves and you throw the ball, or a physical consciousness.
And the same way with the actual physical growth of the plant.

phrases.he: שצריך לזה בחינת צמצום וכיווץ בגלוי זה הרוחני בתחלה,
phrases.en: You need something, some sort of a channeling and a contracting to focus this spiritual power so that it should be revealed *davka* in this way,
so that it should go from spiritual to physical,
like he'll explain in chapter 12.

blocks.text: **Like the power of movement before it actually comes into the physical thing that is moved**, before anything has moved, **or the spiritual power of consciousness before it comes into the actual body to actually perceive**, before the neurochemical signal.

**There, when it goes into the body or the physical thing, it changes from a spiritual thing to a physical thing**: **a physical movement**, your hand throwing the ball, **or a physical consciousness**, light hitting your eye, a chemical reaction in the cones and rods, a signal up the optic nerve. **And the same way with the actual physical growth of the plant**: potential for growth becomes a plant.

Before it can come out from the spiritual to the physical, **you need something, some sort of a channeling and a contracting to focus this spiritual power so that it should be revealed davka in this way, so that it should go from spiritual to physical, like he'll explain in chapter 12.**

blocks.title: A decision kills the other options
blocks.text: Growth needs the seed, and movement needs the same. First you decide in theory that you want to do something and how; then comes something new, deciding to actually do it, and there you pick one movement. In English, he says, decision literally means to kill: you kill off the other options. Then you do it.

So with seeing and hearing: even with brain and eye ready, you see nothing until light hits your eye, and hear nothing until a sound reaches your ear. That is the seed that limits it to one way. In the *meshalim* of *chesed* and movement the *tzimtzum* comes only from you, deciding how; in consciousness and growth you see a seed or trigger, so the need for the *tzimtzum* is easier to see.

reviewQuestions.question: Why must a person contemplate the *Atzmus Or Ein Sof* before learning the details of the *hishtalshelus*, and why is studying it "in detail" a paradox?
What is the difference between *Yachid* and *Echad*, and what do the car, the computer and the pure olive oil show about it?

What does the man on the park bench mean when he says that the kind man's kindness "isn't for anything"?
Why can the ten essential attributes not be called ten things united in the *yechida*?
What are the three levels that come from the *yechida*, and how does the coat at the door show each of them?

notes.text: Mikdash Melech: he says it was written by one of the Arizal's students, "Rabbi Yisrael Saruk, I think was his name", from the Arizal's classes (10 w194-260). The block keeps his words. The printed Mikdash Melech is by Rabbi Shalom Buzaglo (18th century), a commentary on the Zohar that draws on Lurianic teaching in Rabbi Yisrael Saruk's line; a reviewer may want to check what he meant. A garbled phrase there ("he was one of the Arizal's farbrengens", 10 w213-222) is left out of the block.

"In English the word decision means literally like to kill" (17 w2811-2864): kept as he said it. The Latin decidere is de + caedere, "to cut" or "to kill" (as in homicide): to cut off. His gloss is loose, not simply wrong.
